messages:
ci-bot: [ALERT] Nightly perf regression detected on nightly-ci-run-2026-03-15 (job id: run-9876). 95th / p50 token latency up ~18% vs baseline. artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/run-9876
Maya: saw it, waking up to triage. quick summary?
Ajay: saw alert too. can someone attach the perf diff? leaning bisect but let's check kernel/config first.
ci-bot: perf-diff artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/run-9876/perf-diff.json
Sasha: grabbing sampling profiles now, uploading flamegraph in a sec :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Sasha: uploaded flamegraph: https://artifacts.internal/fg/run-9876.svg
Sasha: quick read — more time in AttentionKernel::compute for long seqs, KV cache reuse hit rate dipped ~5%.
Maya: ok can you paste the small profile snippet here?
Sasha: ```
CPU  %  Function
25.3 AttentionKernel::compute
14.8 KVCache::lookup
11.2 Tokenizer::decode
...
```
Ajay: hmm KVCache hit dip could be config change or model variant flip. did nightly switch quantization/profile or runner version?
Linh: rollout note: infra applied model-runner v2.1.4 -> v2.1.5 to staging at 01:10 UTC.
Maya: rollback option? can we re-pin v2.1.4 for tonight if needed?
Ajay: propose repro steps: 1) reproduce locally with bench-runner --model redwood-small --seq 1024 --batch 1; 2) run against v2.1.4 and v2.1.5, compare. if repro, bisect code changes.
Maya: I can run step 1 now, ping me where to upload results.
Sasha: repro command I used:
```
./bench-runner --job nightly --model redwood-small --seq 1024 --batch 1 --seed 42 --out perf.json
```
Ajay: if reproducible, label culprit and start revert. if not, collect kernel logs: /var/log/runtime/kernels.log and enable trace: export RUNTIME_TRACE=1
ci-bot: queued rerun with tracing flags: run-9876-trace (ETA ~12m). link: https://ci.internal/runs/run-9876-trace
Linh: I'm on-call, will monitor the rerun. if trace shows KV misses due to prefix cache TTL bump, config patch could be cache.ttl = 300 -> 60 rollback.
Maya: update: my local run shows ~12% 95th regression vs baseline on v2.1.5. uploading perf.json now.
Sasha: please upload and tag it run-9876-local so we can collate.
Maya: uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/run-9876-local/perf.json
Ajay: OK next steps: Maya run same host with v2.1.4 then v2.1.5 to isolate runner change; Sasha start bisect across commits between those releases; Linh prepare rollback plan.
Maya: starting v2.1.4 run now, ETA ~8m.
(30m later)
Maya: results: v2.1.4 matches baseline, v2.1.5 reproduces regression. confirmed on identical infra.
Ajay: thanks — confirmed runner version is the diff. recommend emergency revert of v2.1.5 to staging and open hotfix for root cause. assign Sasha + Linh.
Sasha: ack. opening revert PR + initial changelog audit. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/3121
Linh: scheduling rollback for 02:30 UTC, will notify infra and incident channel.
Maya: adding notes & artifact links to ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-9876
ci-bot: incident created INC-9876. status: acknowledged.
Ajay: good work team. follow-up: add KV cache hitrate guardrail to nightly smoke tests and an alert threshold so we catch this in pre-staging. I'll file a tracking ticket.
Maya: thanks all, I'll stay on watch until rollback completes.
